assets.name: card_frame.png
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D UI sprite for CHAIN KNIGHTS. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, do not reproduce the board. Match silver metal, sparse chain corners, restrained Arthurian stained-glass geometry. Single isolated asset, face-on orthographic, centered perfectly symmetrical, no perspective, no backdrop, true transparent alpha outside the asset, no text/numbers/logos/watermarks, no cast shadow outside. Crisp bold forms legible at game size. Create ONLY a card FRONT FRAME, portrait 5:7 canvas intended final 300x420. Entire outer card silhouette fills canvas nearly edge to edge, 3 percent margin. Slim white/silver rounded rectangular border with short linked chain ornaments confined strictly to four corners, straight undecorated edge spans suitable for 9-slicing. ALL interior is transparent EMPTY opening: no fill, no emblem, no text boxes, no badge, no gems, no colored glass. Neutral grayscale only so Unity tint works. Four identical balanced corners. Border approximately 14px at final size.

assets.name: card_awaken_glow.png
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Single production 2D game UI VFX overlay for CHAIN KNIGHTS card awakening. True transparent alpha background and completely transparent center. ONLY a slender luminous rounded rectangle outline at 4 percent inset from canvas edges, bright white core light with subtle warm pale gold halo fading into transparent alpha, tiny luminous chain-link suggestions restricted to four corners, very few soft sparks close to border.
